description_en: Queries the list of access restriction URLs configured for a specified browser delivery group or delivery group set by using paging
description_zh: 分页查询指定浏览器交付组或交付组集合下配置的访问限制 URL 列表
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center list-browser-restricted-urls --browser-instance-group-id big-3jm9d0abc00example --browser-instance-group-set-id set-3jm9d0abc00example --keyword example.com --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListBrowserRestrictedURLs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the browser delivery group. You must specify either this parameter or BrowserInstanceGroupSetId, but not both. If you specify this parameter, the restricted URLs configured for the delivery group are queried
parameters.help_zh: 浏览器交付组 ID。与 BrowserInstanceGroupSetId 必须且只能指定一个：指定本参数时查询该交付组下配置的访问限制 URL 列表
parameters.name: browser_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the browser delivery group set. You must specify either this parameter or BrowserInstanceGroupId, but not both
parameters.help_zh: 浏览器交付组集合 ID。BrowserInstanceGroupSetId 与 BrowserInstanceGroupId 必须且只能指定一个
parameters.name: browser_instance_group_set_id

parameters.help_en: The keyword used to filter access control URLs by using a contains match. The match is case-insensitive for English characters. The keyword can be up to 1,024 characters in length after leading and trailing spaces are removed. If you do not specify this parameter or specify only spaces, no filtering is performed. Special characters are matched literally
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制 URL 的包含匹配关键词。英文不区分大小写，去除首尾空白后最多 1024 字符；未传或纯空白表示不筛选，特殊字符按字面匹配
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The number of records to return on each page during paging. Valid values: 1 to 200. Default value: 200. If the value is less than or equal to 0 or greater than 200, a parameter error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页返回的记录数。取值范围 1~200，默认值 200；小于等于 0 或大于 200 时返回参数错误
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number during paging. Default value: 0. If the value is less than 1, such as 0, the first page is returned. If the value is less than 0, a parameter error is returned. Set this parameter to 1 or greater
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时的页码。默认值 0，传入值小于 1（如 0）时按第 1 页处理，小于 0 时返回参数错误；建议从 1 开始传入
parameters.name: page_number

schema.description_en: The response for querying the list of access restriction URLs by using paging, which includes the request ID, paging information, total number of records, and the list of access restriction URLs on the current page
schema.description_zh: 分页查询访问限制 URL 列表的响应，包含请求 ID、分页信息、总记录数和当前页的访问限制 URL 列表

Data.description_en: The list of restricted URLs on the current page. Each record contains a restricted URL and its unique identifier. If no restricted URLs are configured under the specified conditions, an empty array is returned
Data.description_zh: 当前页的访问限制 URL 列表。每条记录包含一个访问限制 URL 及其唯一标识；当指定条件下没有配置任何访问限制 URL 时返回空数组

RestrictedURLId.description_en: The unique identifier of the restricted URL record
RestrictedURLId.description_zh: 访问限制 URL 记录的唯一标识 ID

Url.description_en: The URL address that is restricted from access
Url.description_zh: 被限制访问的 URL 地址

PageNumber.description_en: The actual page number used in this query. This is the echoed value of the PageNumber request parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 本次查询实际使用的页码，为请求参数 PageNumber 的回显值

PageSize.description_en: The actual number of entries returned per page in this query. This is the echoed value of the PageSize request parameter
PageSize.description_zh: 本次查询实际使用的每页数量，为请求参数 PageSize 的回显值

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to locate call records and troubleshoot issues. The example value is partially masked
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的 ID，用于定位调用记录和排查问题。示例为部分脱敏值

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of restricted URL records that meet the filter conditions. This value is independent of the number of records returned on the current page and can be used with PageSize to calculate the total number of pages. If no records meet the conditions, 0 is returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合筛选条件的访问限制 URL 总记录数，与当前页返回的数量无关，可结合 PageSize 计算总页数；没有符合条件的记录时返回 0
